statement: A single-file website for CodeSprint Pune 2027 where students and professionals compare tracks, estimate fees, register teams, and read the schedule, prizes, FAQs and sponsors, and where mentors can sign up.
audience: Students and professionals in and around Pune who want to join the hackathon as participants, plus mentors who want to volunteer.
standards: Energetic and clear look and feel
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file
Menu stays on screen and shows the current section
High-contrast mode applies to the whole page
rules: Show only the first prize for each track; do not invent other prizes
Use placeholders for photos and sponsor logos
Early-bird 10% applies to entry fees only, not meal passes
College name is shown and required only when ticket type is Student
Dietary preference is shown only when meal passes is yes
Do not invent any fact not in the brief
done_when: The site shows the name CodeSprint Pune 2027, that it is a two-day hackathon in Pune, Saturday 6 March 2027, Sunday 7 March 2027 and the venue Lakeside Tech Hall, 12 Lake Road, Pune 411002
A track comparison shows Web Track, AI Track and Hardware Track with team size, build time and first prize for each

A fee calculator takes ticket type (Student or Professional), number of participants (1 to 4) and number of meal passes, and shows the total using Student Rs 400, Professional Rs 800, meal pass Rs 200, with 10% early-bird off entry fees only for registrations up to 15 February 2027

A registration form has team name, lead name, lead email, lead phone, track dropdown, ticket type, college name (Student only, required only then), number of participants (1 to 4), meal passes yes/no and dietary preference (only if meals yes), and sends to register@example.com
A separate mentor form has name, email, area of expertise (Web, AI, Hardware) and availability (Saturday, Sunday or both), and sends to mentors@example.com
A schedule shows day one and day two with every listed time and event
A prizes section shows the first prize for each of the three tracks
An FAQ section answers the six listed questions
A sponsors section shows Gold, Silver and Community tiers with the listed sponsors and logo placeholders
A countdown counts down to the start of the hackathon
A menu stays on screen and highlights the section the visitor is in
A high-contrast mode toggle changes the whole page
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: Work out fees with a calculator
See the day-one and day-two schedule
Mentors sign up with a separate form
facts: Lakeside Tech Hall, 12 Lake Road, Pune 411002
